title: Any signed-in customer can read any invoice
explanation: The route looks an invoice up by id and never checks that it belongs to res.locals.user. Ana can read Ben's invoice just by changing the number in the URL, though a customer may only see their own. Answer 404 unless invoice.customerId matches the signed-in customer (404 rather than 403, so ids can't be probed).

title: Errors send the stack trace and raw message to customers
explanation: err.stack shows file paths and code, and err.message can hold anything, such as a database address. Customers must never see internal details. Log the error on the server and answer a fixed message like { error: 'Something went wrong' }.

title: The summary loads each invoice's lines in turn
explanation: Each await waits for the one before it, so 300 invoices at 20 ms each take about 6 s, far over the one second pages should load in. Start every store.linesOf first and wait with Promise.all, or better, add a store call that loads the lines of all the invoices at once. It's a should, not a must: the answers are right, and it only hurts customers with many invoices.

title: No test asks for another customer's invoice
explanation: The most important rule in the PR is that a customer only sees their own invoices, and every test reads Ana's invoices as Ana. A test where Ana asks for invoice 20 would have caught the must-fix above.
